items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1979-12-05
items.q: So, that's how Peter Bookerage got in the band... And then, like I told you, after when we got through September, I knew I could see the band wasn't going to last long. And we had a really good band.

ctx.x: They'd change that out, but they had enough help, or they had enough guys, but if there wasn't police, then most of the time they'd have to hire police in each city you go in, to be on the boat. I see. I see how they did that, you see. And they had a little small, and they had two smalls, you know, put them in. Sometimes they'd just line them up somewhere and put them somewhere until the boat would come back off its trip, moonlight trip, or something like that. Yeah. It's not a little while. Okay. That's where we…
How was living on a boat?
